$comment: Live surfaces where a transcribed ADR OBPI count is REFUSED (GHI #768). Read by gz validate --transcribed-adr-counts. A surface is listed here because it makes LIVE claims about ADR progress; a file absent from this list is not scanned at all, which is how the 135-file corpus of dated records stays untouched. `historical_sections` names H2/H3 headings inside a listed surface whose content is a dated record rather than a live claim -- a count under one of those is correct as history and must never be rewritten.

surfaces.note: The campaign is both live (the Queue) and archival (Amendments). Section granularity is required, not optional: a whole-file rule would either falsify the amendment record or exempt the banner that started GHI #768.
Quoted the campaign rather than gz adr status and carried 0/9 into a document authored five days after the count changed. The propagation instance in the filed GHI.
